instructions: Do not import this object as vehicle data. Submit an array of real entries to the import command.
Copy exact ID/make/model/year/trim/powertrain/drivetrain/transmission from vehicles-v3.json. Never infer trim from the EPA label.
For every field include URL, retrievedAt, provider, scope, evidence, rawValue, rawUnit, unit, and conversionFactor if applicable.
Use Manufacturer MSRP, Estimated Price, or Dealer Advertised Price accurately. Historical publication date is not automatically MSRP effective date.
Conflicting existing values are retained and audited. Images need matching make/model/year, explicit license and attribution, and a validated cached file checksum.
Insurance, maintenance, resale, ownership and annual emission estimates require method and description in estimationAssumptions.
